purpose: baseline of 0.6.1 (stored-result diagnostics; release gates use the interleaved A/B against the 0.6.0 source tree)
methodology: schema 2.2, Harness V3 (5 warm-ups, 3 x 7 batches, >= 50 ms per sample, median-of-medians), median of three complete runs (tools/ace-repeatability0.6.1.py), interleaved A/B vs the 0.6.0 source tree (3 batches per side, alternating order)

verdict.repeatability: pass, deterministic values identical over 3 runs x 30 families; macro spread <= 5 % (compression, observed maximum 2.1 %) / <= 15 % (decompression, observed maximum 8.9 %)
verdict.ab_vs_0_6_0: pass, 18 / 18 cases; byte-identical output on the unchanged paths (FAST / BALANCED encode 0.973 / 0.981, decode 0.984 - 0.988, f64_noisy 0.997); paths whose bytes change on purpose: DENSE encode 0.568 (floor 0.50), delta-variable encode 0.799 (floor 0.75), monotonic-outliers 0.956 (floor 0.70), int-counter-reset 1.755, decimal-price encode 1.724 / decode 3.462
verdict.fuzz: 18 / 18 targets, no crash (FUZZ.md); ts1_decode and ts1_roundtrip logged 5487 s of wall time for 600 s (suspected host suspend, see FUZZ.md)

allocation: engine bytes per input byte (mixed 4 MiB, 16 blocks): Fast 5.9, Balanced 8.3, Dense 18.2 (0.6.0: 11.1, DENSE plans every block as BALANCED too)
files: benchmark-0.6.1-<family>.json (33 families incl. regression, repeatability, format-1-5 and chimp-evaluation; public-corpus is empty, ACE_PUBLIC_CORPUS was not set) and ab-0.6.1-vs-0.6.0.json, unchanged from the run
note: reference run of the 0.6.1 release on the author's workstation (performance governor, 32-34 C), third A/B run after the planner cost reductions; code revision 68a6a44 (the merge only adds documentation). Decode of delta-variable is 0.47x of 0.6.0 (861 vs 1837 MB/s) for a 37 % smaller output, DENSE encode is 0.57x: both are documented trade-offs (docs/RELEASE-NOTES-0.6.1.md).
